assertions.name: reproduces_the_corpus_h3_trace_vector
assertions.source: all six slots of pyhecke.gram's TR_M, symbolic in (h, z): ['1', 'z', 'z', 'z**2', 'z**2', 'h*z**2 + z']; mismatches: none

assertions.name: trace_property_holds_on_h4_pairs
assertions.source: tr(xy) = tr(yx) on 6 pairs of H_4 basis elements, symbolic in (h, z). This is not an input to the recursion -- a coset-bookkeeping error would surface here. Failures: none

assertions.name: markov_property_n4_against_n3
assertions.source: tr_4(x * T_2) = z * tr_3(x) on all 6 H_3 basis elements, symbolic in (h, z). Failures: none

assertions.name: four_strand_trace_set_is_larger_and_wider
assertions.source: n = 3: 9 traces in [0.18618696, 1.0]; n = 4: 511 traces in [0.11139758, 1.1374052] (k <= 8 vertices, z_D at the proton pin)

assertions.name: four_strand_set_is_denser_so_a_residual_match_means_less
assertions.source: median gap between consecutive distinct traces: n = 3 0.032897756, n = 4 0.0025322918 -- a factor 12.9913 denser. Selection by residual was already forbidden at n = 3 (the difference grid straddled Q_beta with a 1.29 % spacing); at n = 4 it is not even tempting

description: A general-n Ocneanu/Markov trace built from tr(1)=1, tr(xy)=tr(yx) and the Markov property, via the S_{n-1}-coset decomposition. Validated three ways: it reproduces pyhecke.gram's hand-coded H_3 vector [1,z,z,z^2,z^2,z(hz+1)] symbolically, it satisfies the trace property on H_4 pairs, and it satisfies the Markov property at n=4 against n=3. Then measures the four-strand gamma-gamma trace set at z_D, proton pin, with n=3 as control. Scope-(a): NO four-strand Q_beta prediction is made -- E_0 and the element-to-observable map are H_3 constructions and the corpus does not define their n=4 analogue.

data.recursion: w in S_{n-1} -> tr_{n-1}(T_w); else w = u*c_j with c_j = s_{n-2}...s_j, and tr_n(T_w) = z * tr_{n-1}(T_b * T_u) with b = s_{n-3}...s_j, by cyclicity + the Markov property
what_this_does_not_do: no four-strand Q_beta prediction -- E_0 and the element-to-observable map are H_3 constructions and the corpus does not define their n = 4 analogue
the n = 4 trace set is compared to ITSELF at n = 3, structurally, never against a measured value
